threads.body: _interaction_request() returns getattr(body, "__dict__", body) for request.body models. For Pydantic v2 models this can include defaulted fields (not just explicitly supplied ones), which risks recording gen_ai.request.* attributes even when the caller didn’t set them—contradicting the README/PR claim that only explicitly supplied configuration is captured. Prefer dumping only “unset-excluded” fields when model_dump() is available, and fall back to __dict__ only when there’s no structured dump API.
